system.creatureSubtype: immune to Frightened, Prone; immune to mind-affecting effects; does not need air, food, drink, or sleep
system.tactics: Gibbering Mouthers do not have tactics. They surge toward creatures and gibber. A summoner who calls one needs to accept that the Gibbering affect their allies too unless those allies are out of range. They are useful for area denial or as a terrifying distraction. Their cooperation is genuine; their execution is chaotic.
system.attacksNotes:
Bite (Multiple) [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 6 + Melee Combat 2), Reach: 5 ft

  • Margin 1:: 10 damage (7 + 3 Str)
  • Margin 2: 10 damage, DR halved (round up); target makes Fortitude [Easy] save or is Grappled by one of the mouths. While Grappled this way, target takes 4 damage at the start of each of their turns.
  • Margin 3: 10 damage, DR halved (round up); Grappled (no save)
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Gibbering: All creatures within 20 feet that can hear the Gibbering Mouther and are not Aberrations must make a Will [Easy] save at the start of their turn. On failure, they cannot use reactions until the start of their next turn and must move in a random direction before acting (rolled by GM). Blinding Spittle (Recharge 5-8): Ranged attack against one creature within 30 feet. Target makes Reflex [Easy] save or gains Blinded condition for 1 minute (Fortitude [Easy] save each turn to remove). Ground Destabilization: The area within 5 feet of the Gibbering Mouther becomes Difficult Terrain.
